errors.evidence: The x-axis uses a linear scale, not a logarithmic one. The intervals (0, 0.1, 0.2...) are evenly spaced.

errors.text_span: eine Nachfrage von 8,000 MW verzeichnet wird
errors.evidence: At a bonus of 0.9, the demand for all three lines (minimum, mean, maximum) is 10,000 MW, not 8,000 MW.

errors.text_span: einen Wert von ungefähr 8,000 MW erreicht
errors.evidence: For the mean demand line, the value at a bonus of 0.4 is exactly 10,000 MW, not approximately 8,000 MW.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bei einem Bonus von 0,9 auf 8,000 MW sinkt
errors.evidence: The mean demand line does not sink. It remains constant at 10,000 MW from a bonus of 0.4 to 0.9.
None of the lines in the chart are dashed ('gestrichelt'); they are all solid lines.

errors.text_span: einen Wert von ungefähr 4,000 MW erreicht
errors.evidence: For the minimum demand line, the value at a bonus of 0.4 is exactly 10,000 MW, not approximately 4,000 MW.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bei einem Bonus von 0,9 auf 0 MW sinkt
errors.evidence: The minimum demand line does not sink. It remains constant at 10,000 MW from a bonus of 0.4 to 0.9.
There is no yellow ('gelbe') line in the chart. All three lines are shades of blue.
